code: cat(naxp_emit(r"(\9\9\9\9 \s!! \A\A)", "javascript", prefix = "nl_postcode")) #> /** The naxp this code was generated from. */ #> const nl_postcodePattern = '\\9\\9\\9\\9 \\s!! \\A\\A'; #>  #> /** The largest encoded value this naxp produces, which is also how many it has. */ #> const nl_postcodeMaxEncodedValue = 6_760_000; #>  #> /** The length of the longest string this naxp can decode a value to. */ #> const nl_postcodeMaxLength = 7; #>  #> /** Whether this naxp accepts a string, or the ASCII text in a Uint8Array. A byte outside ASCII is never accepted. #>  * @param {string | Uint8Array} text #>  * @returns {boolean} #>  */ #> function nl_postcodeAccepts(text) { #> 	const bytes = typeof text !== 'string'; #> 	let state = 0; #>  #> 	for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { #> 		const c = bytes ? text[i] : text.charCodeAt(i); #>  #> 		state = nl_postcodeAcceptStep(state, c); #>  #> 		if (state < 0) { return false; } #> 	} #>  #> 	return nl_postcodeIsAccepting(state); #> } #>  #> /** The encoded value of a string, or of the ASCII text in a Uint8Array, from 1 to the largest encoded value, or zero where it is invalid. #>  * @param {string | Uint8Array} text #>  * @returns {number} #>  */ #> function nl_postcodeEncode(text) { #> 	const canonical = nl_postcodeCanonicalise(text); #>  #> 	return canonical === null ? 0 : nl_postcodeRank(canonical); #> } #>  #> /** The string a value stands for, which is in canonical form. #>  * @param {number} value #>  * @returns {string} #>  * @throws {RangeError} The value is not one this naxp produces. #>  */ #> function nl_postcodeDecode(value) { #> 	if (value < 1 || value > nl_postcodeMaxEncodedValue) { #> 		throw new RangeError('This naxp encodes the values 1 to 6760000.'); #> 	} #>  #> 	return String.fromCharCode.apply(null, nl_postcodeDecodeCore(value)); #> } #>  #> /** The string a value stands for, as ASCII bytes. #>  * @param {number} value #>  * @returns {Uint8Array} #>  * @throws {RangeError} The value is not one this naxp produces. #>  */ #> function nl_postcodeDecodeToBytes(value) { #> 	if (value < 1 || value > nl_postcodeMaxEncodedValue) { #> 		throw new RangeError('This naxp encodes the values 1 to 6760000.'); #> 	} #>  #> 	return Uint8Array.from(nl_postcodeDecodeCore(value)); #> } #>  #> /** The string a value stands for, which is in canonical form, or null where the value is not one this naxp produces. #>  * @param {number} value #>  * @returns {string | null} #>  */ #> function nl_postcodeTryDecode(value) { #> 	if (value < 1 || value > nl_postcodeMaxEncodedValue) { return null; } #>  #> 	return String.fromCharCode.apply(null, nl_postcodeDecodeCore(value)); #> } #>  #> /** The canonical form of a string, or of the ASCII text in a Uint8Array, or null where it is invalid. #>  * @param {string | Uint8Array} text #>  * @returns {string | null} #>  */ #> function nl_postcodeGetCanonicalForm(text) { #> 	const canonical = nl_postcodeCanonicalise(text); #>  #> 	return canonical === null ? null : String.fromCharCode.apply(null, canonical); #> } #>  #> /** The code points of the canonical form of a string, or of the ASCII text in a Uint8Array, or null where it is invalid. */ #> function nl_postcodeCanonicalise(text) { #> 	const bytes = typeof text !== 'string'; #> 	const canonical = []; #> 	let state = 0; #>  #> 	for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { #> 		const c = bytes ? text[i] : text.charCodeAt(i); #>  #> 		state = nl_postcodeCanonicalStep(state, c, canonical); #>  #> 		if (state < 0) { return null; } #> 	} #>  #> 	return nl_postcodeFinishCanonical(state, canonical) ? canonical : null; #> } #>  #> /** The rank of a canonical string, as code points, within the canonical language, or zero where it is not in it. */ #> function nl_postcodeRank(codes) { #> 	const acc = { total: 0 }; #> 	let state = 0; #>  #> 	for (let i = 0; i < codes.length; i++) { #> 		state = nl_postcodeEncodeStep(state, codes[i], acc); #>  #> 		if (state < 0) { return 0; } #> 	} #>  #> 	return nl_postcodeIsCanonicalAccepting(state) ? acc.total + 1 : 0; #> } #>  #> /** The code points of an encoded value already checked against the largest one. */ #> function nl_postcodeDecodeCore(value) { #> 	const codes = []; #> 	const box = { remaining: value }; #> 	let state = 0; #>  #> 	while (state >= 0) { #> 		state = nl_postcodeDecodeStep(state, box, codes); #> 	} #>  #> 	return codes; #> } #>  #> /** The acceptor's transition: the next state, or -1 where the code point fits nothing. */ #> function nl_postcodeAcceptStep(state, c) { #> 	switch (state) { #> 		case 0: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { return 1; } #> 			break; #> 		case 1: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { return 2; } #> 			break; #> 		case 2: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { return 3; } #> 			break; #> 		case 3: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { return 4; } #> 			break; #> 		case 4: #> 			if (c === 0x20) { return 5; } #> 			if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5A) { return 6; } #> 			break; #> 		case 5: #> 			if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5A) { return 6; } #> 			break; #> 		case 6: #> 			if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5A) { return 7; } #> 			break; #> 		case 7: #> 			break; #> 	} #>  #> 	return -1; #> } #>  #> /** Whether the input may end in this state. */ #> function nl_postcodeIsAccepting(state) { #> 	switch (state) { #> 		case 7: #> 			return true; #> 		default: #> 			return false; #> 	} #> } #>  #> /** The canonical machine's transition, accumulating the values skipped: the next state, or -1. */ #> function nl_postcodeEncodeStep(state, c, acc) { #> 	switch (state) { #> 		case 0: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { acc.total += 676_000 * (c - 0x30); return 1; } #> 			break; #> 		case 1: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { acc.total += 67_600 * (c - 0x30); return 2; } #> 			break; #> 		case 2: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { acc.total += 6760 * (c - 0x30); return 3; } #> 			break; #> 		case 3: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { acc.total += 676 * (c - 0x30); return 4; } #> 			break; #> 		case 4: #> 			if (c === 0x20) { return 5; } #> 			break; #> 		case 5: #> 			if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5A) { acc.total += 26 * (c - 0x41); return 6; } #> 			break; #> 		case 6: #> 			if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5A) { acc.total += (c - 0x41); return 7; } #> 			break; #> 		case 7: #> 			break; #> 	} #>  #> 	return -1; #> } #>  #> /** Whether the input may end in this state. */ #> function nl_postcodeIsCanonicalAccepting(state) { #> 	switch (state) { #> 		case 7: #> 			return true; #> 		default: #> 			return false; #> 	} #> } #>  #> /** One step of decoding: appends at most one code point and returns the next state, or -1 when the string is complete. */ #> function nl_postcodeDecodeStep(state, box, codes) { #> 	let index; #>  #> 	switch (state) { #> 		case 0: { #> 			index = Math.floor((box.remaining - 1) / 676_000); #> 			codes.push(0x30 + index); #> 			box.remaining = ((box.remaining - 1) % 676_000) + 1; #> 			return 1; #> 		} #> 		case 1: { #> 			index = Math.floor((box.remaining - 1) / 67_600); #> 			codes.push(0x30 + index); #> 			box.remaining = ((box.remaining - 1) % 67_600) + 1; #> 			return 2; #> 		} #> 		case 2: { #> 			index = Math.floor((box.remaining - 1) / 6760); #> 			codes.push(0x30 + index); #> 			box.remaining = ((box.remaining - 1) % 6760) + 1; #> 			return 3; #> 		} #> 		case 3: { #> 			index = Math.floor((box.remaining - 1) / 676); #> 			codes.push(0x30 + index); #> 			box.remaining = ((box.remaining - 1) % 676) + 1; #> 			return 4; #> 		} #> 		case 4: { #> 			codes.push(0x20); #> 			return 5; #> 		} #> 		case 5: { #> 			index = Math.floor((box.remaining - 1) / 26); #> 			codes.push(0x41 + index); #> 			box.remaining = ((box.remaining - 1) % 26) + 1; #> 			return 6; #> 		} #> 		case 6: { #> 			index = box.remaining - 1; #> 			codes.push(0x41 + index); #> 			box.remaining = 1; #> 			return 7; #> 		} #> 		case 7: { #> 			return -1; #> 		} #> 	} #>  #> 	return -1; #> } #>  #> /** The canonicalising transition, appending what reading the code point emits: the next state, or -1. */ #> function nl_postcodeCanonicalStep(state, c, canonical) { #> 	switch (state) { #> 		case 0: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { #> 				canonical.push(c); #> 				return 1; #> 			} #> 			break; #> 		case 1: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { #> 				canonical.push(c); #> 				return 2; #> 			} #> 			break; #> 		case 2: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { #> 				canonical.push(c); #> 				return 3; #> 			} #> 			break; #> 		case 3: #> 			if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) { #> 				canonical.push(c); #> 				return 4; #> 			} #> 			break; #> 		case 4: #> 			if (c === 0x20) { return 5; } #> 			if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5A) { #> 				canonical.push(0x20); #> 				canonical.push(c); #> 				return 6; #> 			} #> 			break; #> 		case 5: #> 			if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5A) { #> 				canonical.push(0x20); #> 				canonical.push(c); #> 				return 6; #> 			} #> 			break; #> 		case 6: #> 			if (c >= 0x41 && c <= 0x5A) { #> 				canonical.push(c); #> 				return 7; #> 			} #> 			break; #> 		case 7: #> 			break; #> 	} #>  #> 	return -1; #> } #>  #> /** Appends what ending the input emits, and returns whether the input may end here. */ #> function nl_postcodeFinishCanonical(state, canonical) { #> 	switch (state) { #> 		case 7: #> 			return true; #> 	} #>  #> 	return false; #> }
